settings.intro_en: Mazrood is a Saudi casual formal brand, founded in Riyadh in 2016. Shop shirts, knitwear, jackets and everyday essentials. Shown at Riyadh Fashion Week.
settings.intro_ar: مزرود علامة سعودية للأزياء الكاجوال الفورمال، تأسست في الرياض عام 2016. تسوق القمصان والتريكو والجاكيتات والأساسيات اليومية.

settings.body: Mazrood is a studio before it is a label. We design quietly, produce slowly, and release only what we believe belongs in the wardrobe for years — not weeks.

settings.title: Cut with intent
settings.copy: Every pattern starts as a question: what does this garment need to do — and nothing more. We strip until only the essential remains.

settings.title: Built to outlast
settings.copy: Seasons pass; the pieces stay. We choose fabrics and construction that age into character rather than out of relevance.

settings.title: Made in the studio
settings.copy: Nothing leaves the studio until we would wear it ourselves. Small runs, considered details, no shortcuts.
